visual.name: smartVisualsCountdown
visual.description: Free countdown and days-since timer. Counts down to a deadline and up from the last event, with streak records, working-day and business-hour counting, explicit time zones and a local-or-UTC day rollover. Ticks live between dataset refreshes. Part of the SmartVisuals visual family for Power BI.

en-US.Visual_Clock_Stale: model clock is older than this device's; using the device clock
en-US.Visual_Landing_Demo: until the end of this month
en-US.Visual_Landing_Hint: Drop a date column on Deadline to count down to it, or on Event dates to count the days since. No data to hand? Type a date in the Countdown card.
en-US.Visual_NoDate: No date to count to yet - bind a date column, or set one in the Countdown card.
en-US.Visual_NoTimeLeft: no time left to make it up
en-US.Visual_Role_actual_desc: How much is done so far. With Goal and a window, the visual reports the run rate you still need.
en-US.Visual_Role_events_desc: Dates of the events to count up FROM - incidents, resets, releases. Bind the whole column and the visual also reports the best streak on record.
en-US.Visual_Role_goal_desc: The number Actual has to reach by the deadline.
en-US.Visual_Role_holidays_desc: Dates that are never working days - public holidays, shutdown weeks. Use a column from the same table as your dates.
en-US.Visual_Role_reference_desc: Optional model clock, e.g. UTCNOW(). Used only to correct a viewer device clock that is running behind.
en-US.Visual_Role_start_desc: Start of the window, for the progress layout.
en-US.Visual_Role_target_desc: The date to count down to. Leave empty and set a date in the format pane instead.
en-US.Visual_Role_tooltips_desc: Extra fields to show in the tooltip.
en-US.Visual_SkippedRows: rows were not dates and were skipped
en-US.Visual_Warn_Dates_Detail: Rows holding a value that is not a date were skipped. Numbers are never read as dates on purpose - an Excel serial, Unix seconds and Unix milliseconds are indistinguishable, and guessing wrong is silently wrong. Convert the column to a date type in the model.
en-US.Visual_Warn_Zone_Detail: The zone entered is not a valid IANA name. The report viewer's own zone is being used instead. Names look like Europe/Prague or America/New_York.
en-US.Visual_board_showMoreFooter: Say How Many Rows Are Hidden
en-US.Visual_board_showRowDate: Show The Date On Each Row
en-US.Visual_board_showRowState: Show State Chip On Each Row
en-US.Visual_countdown_targetPick: When The Column Has Many Dates
en-US.Visual_diagnostics_showClockConfidence: Show Where The Clock Comes From
en-US.Visual_diagnostics_showSkipped: Warn About Rows That Are Not Dates
en-US.Visual_streak_showBestDate: Show When The Best Was Set
en-US.Visual_text_autoFit: Fit The Number To The Visual
en-US.Visual_timezone_showZoneChip: Show The Zone On The Visual
